# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows caster to research special imbedding spells to be used in creating
items.
@@ 3
Allows caster to imbed a 1st level spell from any realm in an item or potion.
@@ 4
Allows caster to charge a Wand from any realm.
@@ 5
As Imbed I, except 1st to 2nd level spells can be imbedded.
@@ 6
Allows caster to imbed a 1st level spell from any realm (using an Imbed spell)
that can be cast once per day.
@@ 7
As Imbed I, except 1st to 3rd level spells can be imbedded.
@@ 8
As Charge Wand, except a Rod from any realm can be charged.
@@ 9
As Imbed I, but 1st to 4th level spells can be imbedded.
@@ 10
As Daily I, except 1st to 3rd level spells can be imbedded; a 1st level spell
could be cast 3 times per day; a 2nd or 3rd, once per day.
@@ 11
As Imbed I, except 1st to 5th level spells can be imbedded.
@@ 12
As Charge Wand, except a Staff from any realm can be charged.
@@ 13
As Imbed I, except 1st to 6th level spells can be imbedded.
@@ 14
As Daily 1, except 1st to 5th level spells can be imbedded: a 1st level spell
could be cast 5 times per day; a 2nd or 3rd 2x/day; a 4th or 5th, once per
day.
@@ 15
As Imbed I, except 1st to 7th level spells can be imbedded.
@@ 20
As Imbed I, except 1st to 10th level spells can be imbedded.
@@ 25
As Daily I, except 1st to 10th level spells can be imbedded; a 1st level spell
could be cast 10 times per day; a 2nd 5x/day; a 3rd 3x/day; a 4th or 5th
2x/day; a 6th, 7th, 8th, 9th, or 10th, once per day.
@@ 30
Allows a spell of 1st to 10th level from any realm to be imbedded (using an
Imbed spell) so that it functions constantly.
@@ 50
As Imbed I, except any level spell from any realm can be imbedded.
@@ 75
As Daily I, except 1st to 20th level spells of any realm can be imbedded: a
1st level spell could be cast 20 time a day; a 2nd, 10x/day; a 3rd, 6x/day; a
4th, 5x/day; a 5th, 4x/day; a 6th, 3x/day; a 7th, 8th, 9th or 10th 2x/day;
11th through 20th once per day.
@@ 90
As Constant, except a 1st to 20th level spell of any realm may be imbedded so
that it functions constantly.
@@ 110
As Lord Daily except 1st to 50th level spells of any realm can be imbedded: a
1st level spell could be cast 50 times per day; a 2nd, 25x/day; a 3rd,
16x/day; a 4th, 12x/day; a 5th, 10x/day; a 6th, 8x/day; a 7th, 7x/day; an 8th,
6x/day; a 9th or 10th, 5x/day; an 11th or 12th, 4x/ day;a 13th, 14th, 15th, or
16th, 3x/ a day; a 17th through 25th, 2x/day; and a 26th through 50th once per
day.
@@ 130
As Constant, except a 1st to 50th level spell of any realm may be imbedded so
that functions constantly.
